findings.title: Capability matrix is catalogued but not executable
evidence: The IMPLEMENTED set covers the core read surface and one file mutation capability.
Descriptors without an adapter are registered unavailable and return NOT_READY.
The capability runtime dispatches only zos.files.mutate-propose.

findings.title: Parity CI is one-directional
evidence: The test checks manifest routes against known API routes.
It does not fail for an actionable REST/UI route missing from the manifest.

findings.title: Native MCP Tasks are not implemented
evidence: The documented implementation uses zos.runs.* for both protocol eras because SDK 2.3.1 lacks server Tasks runtime support.

findings.title: Rollout observability and shadow comparison are missing
evidence: The MCP handler has request logging and limits but no OpenTelemetry capability metrics.
No REST/MCP shadow comparator or staged parity gate is present.
